purpose: body_general_5 shoulder and neck worn-state correction
processing: Alpha-preserving WebP format conversion only; no local matte extraction, pixel masks or background removal. Garment contours and neck opening use imagegen-native alpha. Original skin is restored between career clothing and the front collar; no rectangular torso replacement.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production RPG paper-doll WORN upper-body armor replacement, male fit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing transparent full-body male character. Image 2 is only the armor design/material reference.
Edit Image 1 in place: dress this same person in the interstellar expedition breastplate from Image 2, fitted physically around their actual torso and BOTH SHOULDERS. This is a wear/try-on edit, not a sticker pasted over the sweatshirt.
Keep the exact full-body 2:3 canvas, camera, character scale, limb axes, position, facial identity, hair, head, exposed front neck, hands, relaxed hand poses, trousers, boots, and transparent background of Image 1. Do not crop or recenter the figure. Only replace the upper torso garment and cover shoulder crowns/upper deltoids.
Armor design: layered curved pearlescent silver-white chest plates, fine champagne-gold seams, black flexible underarmor in the joints, one small cyan triangular sternum core. Faithful to Image 2, no extra accessories. Tailor the breastplate to this person's natural broad male chest, shoulders and straight waist.
CRITICAL PHYSICAL FIT: rounded shoulder pauldrons must sit OVER the real shoulder crowns and wrap outward/down around upper arms; no gray sweatshirt shoulders poking above or outside the pauldrons. Connect shoulders to the cuirass with visible layered straps/hinges and believable ambient contact shadow. Keep gray sleeves below the upper-arm armor, unchanged wrist locations.
CRITICAL NECK DEPTH: the tall dark INNER BACK COLLAR is BEHIND the human neck, partly hidden by it. The visible human throat sits inside the collar opening. The lower front silver collar rim curves around the base of the neck and occludes only its lower edge. NO black oval filled over the throat, no mannequin cavity painted in front of the human neck. The neck must clearly emerge THROUGH the collar, not stop above a flat black sticker.
Hem ends at the existing waistline, covering the sweatshirt torso without covering or moving the trousers. Realistic fitted clothing, coherent lighting, occlusion and soft contact shadows. Make it look genuinely worn.
Preserve native TRUE ALPHA transparency outside the person. Do not paint black, white or checkerboard background. No helmet, no gloves, no weapon, no shield, no text, no border, no scene. Exactly one character in the original unchanged pose.
attempts.reason: Worn anatomy useful, but opaque checkerboard output rejected as a game asset.
